source.prompt: Generate one image. NES 8-bit pixel art character sprite, bold black outlines, flat colors, limited NES palette, no gradients, no anti-aliasing. An adult TV news anchor: a man in his mid 40s with short graying hair, wearing a charcoal gray suit, white shirt and a dark red tie. Front view, facing the viewer, head and upper torso only, cut off at mid-chest by the bottom edge of the image, arms down at the sides. Calm, neutral, professional expression, eyes open looking at the viewer, mouth closed. Adult proportions: realistic head-to-body ratio, normal-size eyes; not chibi, not anime, not a mascot, not a cartoon caricature. An original character who does not resemble any real person. The figure is centered and fills most of the frame height, with a small margin above the head. Background: one completely flat solid pure green color (#00FF00), no desk, no studio, no shadows, no other objects. No text, no letters, no logos, no badges, no flags, no microphones, no earpieces.

eyes_closed.prompt: Edit this image. Show the same person with both eyes fully closed, as in a natural blink. Change nothing else: keep exactly the same pose, framing, size and position in the image, the same face, hair, clothing, colors, pixel-art style and the same flat green background. No text.
